# Third-party notices and asset provenance

This package is prepared for the user's private team repository and demo handoff. Public distribution requires confirming rights to the supplied LiteJam models, branding and imported songs. Version 0.1.1 includes the previous project's Guitar Pro test collection at the user's explicit request on 5 November 2026; this supersedes the original generated-exercises-only packaging choice. Original song bytes and source-relative provenance are recorded in Source docs/song-library-inventory.json.

- **Three.js 0.180.0:** MIT, https://github.com/mrdoob/three. License in `licenses/three.txt`.
- **alphaTab 1.9.0:** MPL-2.0, https://github.com/CoderLine/alphaTab. Unmodified npm distribution; license in `licenses/alphatab.txt`. Corresponding library source is available from the linked project/tag. Bravura font and SONiVOX SoundFont ship with alphaTab; bundled notices are preserved under `licenses/alphatab-assets` and inside the build's font/soundfont folders.
- **Inter 4.1:** SIL Open Font License 1.1. https://rsms.me/inter/; downloaded `InterVariable.woff2` from https://rsms.me/inter/font-files/InterVariable.woff2?v=4.1. License in `public/assets/fonts/LICENSE.txt` (Demo: `dist/assets/fonts/LICENSE.txt`).
- **Phosphor Icons:** MIT, https://github.com/phosphor-icons/core. Only nine regular SVGs included, from the official repository. License beside the icons. Their exact bytes are captured in the package manifest.
- **LiteJam white logo:** https://litejam.com/cdn/shop/files/Logo_Litejam_White.png?v=1790329642&width=574, used unchanged as the user's reference brand. LiteJam marks remain their owner's property.
- **LiteJam guitar models:** RGB24, A1, RGB24M, RGB24NEOS, RGB24NEOT, supplied by the user via Google Drive and previously calibrated in the original project. Original model and calibration bytes are retained; hashes in Source `tests/fixtures/asset-hashes.json`.
- **Original Stratocaster:** Peak_Creation, “Fender Stratocaster Guitar 3D Guitar Model”, CC BY 4.0. https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/fender-stratocaster-guitar-3d-guitar-model-f11a4e67436841e0b8ed50352431a855. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. The application hides supplied strings and generates calibrated interactive strings/LEDs, and divides finish surfaces at runtime.
- **Wood finish maps:** Poly Haven, CC0. Individual authors, source URLs and SHA-256 values are retained in `assets/finishes/catalog.json` under public (Source) or dist (Demo). Carbon weave is the locally generated appearance reference from the original project. No production suitability is asserted.
- **Demo exercises:** Original project-authored String Motion, Strum Circuit and Fret Journey, plus First Light generated for this app by `scripts/make-demos.mjs`. These are functional exercises, not imported commercial songs.
- **User-provided song collection:** Flight of the Bumblebee, LOSO Som Sarn (solo), LOSO Yahk Hen Nah Koon, and original LED/timing/alignment exercises copied unchanged from the user's original project. These files remain their respective owners' material; inclusion here does not assign a new license.
- **Node.js 24.18.0 Windows x64:** Official nodejs.org binary, SHA-256 checked against its official SHASUMS256.txt. Portable Demo includes full Node license and provenance under `runtime/`. Node license contains its bundled third-party notices.

The source uses Vite 8.3.5 (MIT) and @coderline/alphatab-vite 1.9.0 at build time. Package versions are pinned in package-lock.json. These build dependencies are fetched by npm ci and are not bundled as development tools in the Portable Demo.
